subject: [NAME] - Physical AI
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following the work of your team building and validating [COMPANY]'s AI
driver, especially around scenario coverage and deployment readiness. I
work closely with Woven (Toyota), Boston Dynamics, and 1X Robotics who are
tackling similar problems.

consistently surfacing eade cases and perception model failures across

repeatable evaluation loops without overloading engineering teams. That's
where Encord tends to fit.

If this overlaps with what your org is focused on as you scale deployments,
I'd love 20min to compare notes - would Tue or Wed work for you?
